conventions.space: Carrier root space equals Blender scene space at root identity; each K1 bone matrix is K1 armature space
conventions.matrix: row-major 4x4 arrays, translation in last column; column-vector multiplication
conventions.quaternion: WXYZ. Convert ordering when using Unity APIs.
conventions.pose_retarget: Convert coordinate basis and rig object transforms first. D=sourcePose*inverse(sourceRest); targetPose=D*targetRest. Convert to target parent-relative transform afterwards. Blender Euler/basis delta is not Unity localRotation.
conventions.object_scale: K1 and carrier root/mesh scale=(1,1,1). Mask rigid parts were neither resized nor deformed.

procedure_status: 정화통 부착 수납은 이번 체험 구성. 실제 군 수납 절차 아님.

stored.align_to: Anchor_MaskStored matches K1 Anchor_FaceFit; solve K1 root using inverse FaceFit local frame

donning_loose_target.use: After full extraction, transition the folded harness toward this loose pose. This target is data only; transition interpolation and user-controlled path require Unity integration.

extraction.method: Actual evaluated triangles of all 9 K1 meshes against all 8 carrier render meshes at 81 equally spaced translations. Not merely an AABB test.

pickup.surface: Part_Facepiece actual upper rubber triangle +1mm outward
pickup.binding: Bind MaskInteractionFrame to actual K1 root after pickup, or reparent Anchor_MaskPickup preserving its local-to-K1 frame. No K1 objects exported in bag FBX.

known_source_contact.part: Original Attach_P_LD fixed free-tail geometry versus Part_FilterCanister
known_source_contact.limitation: 본래 K1 꼬리/정화통 겹침은 가방 간섭과 별개. 꼬리 전용 변형 본 또는 해당 Key/형상 재검토가 향후 필요. 기존 원본은 수정하지 않음.
